title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Your Name"
date: 2026-09-09
---

The start of the MDS program has been fast-moving and exciting. The content during the first week of classes was not exceptionally difficult, but the processes related to submitting assignments and saving work was new to me.

I was surprised how quickly the assignments piled up. Now I chip away at them constantly so I don't feel the pressure before a deadline.

I am looking forward to the rest of the program, especially some of the opportunities to complete projects or research. I feel confident in my ability to do well.
